reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker or PD data available to assess target engagement for any of the three compounds (ipilimumab, nivolumab, cabozantinib). Cannot determine if CTLA-4, PD-1, or VEGFR2/MET/KIT were adequately engaged. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to assess whether checkpoint blockade or kinase inhibition pathways were activated. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The trial was terminated early with only 4 patients enrolled. PFS of 6.24 months is reported but without a comparator or statistical analysis (no p-value). The trial was withdrawn due to lack of sponsor support from BMS, not for efficacy or safety reasons per se. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: With only 4 patients, no meaningful subgroup analysis possible. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be primarily a commercial decision (withdrawn sponsor support) rather than a scientific failure. The extremely small sample size (n=4) makes any efficacy assessment meaningless. High toxicity rate (50% grade ≥3 AEs, multiple serious immune-related AEs) may have contributed to early termination.
